extension.summary: AB Tools - all-in-one Kodi maintenance and skin toolkit
extension.description: ABUKARIM TOOLS is an all-in-one utility for managing your Kodi setup. It bundles a Skin Installer and Skin Switcher, full backup and restore of your userdata, and quick access to the ABUKARIM Wizard and its maintenance tools (Total Clean and old thumbnail cleanup). A built-in patcher keeps popular add-ons (Seren, Prism, TinyPPI, Arctic Fuse 3, TMDbHelper, RedLight and more) working correctly on CoreELEC and Kodi, and re-applies its fixes automatically after those add-ons update. Also includes handy maintenance tools such as a speed test, a CPU benchmark and an add-on database rebuild.
extension.summary: أدوات أبوكريم - حزمة متكاملة لصيانة كودي وإدارة الواجهات
extension.description: أدوات أبوكريم هي أداة شاملة لإدارة نظام كودي لديك. تجمع بين مثبّت الواجهات ومبدّل الواجهات، والنسخ الاحتياطي الكامل لبيانات المستخدم واستعادتها، ووصولاً سريعاً إلى معالج أبوكريم وأدوات الصيانة فيه (التنظيف الشامل وحذف الصور المصغّرة القديمة). كما تتضمّن أداة ترقيع مدمجة تُبقي الإضافات الشائعة (Seren وTinyPPI وArctic Fuse 3 وTMDbHelper وRedLight وغيرها) تعمل بشكل صحيح على CoreELEC وكودي، وتعيد تطبيق إصلاحاتها تلقائياً بعد تحديث تلك الإضافات. وتشمل أيضاً أدوات صيانة مفيدة مثل اختبار السرعة واختبار أداء المعالج وإعادة بناء قاعدة بيانات الإضافات.
extension.news: v4.7.1 - Setup: add-ons the restore already installed are not downloaded again; add-ons installed from a zip are registered with Kodi before they are enabled (no more ~8 s wait and "enable this add-on?" fallback per add-on). v4.7.0 - Installation Wizard rework: checks before setup (clock sync, internet, free space); every question is asked first with a summary page (Start / Change answers), then setup runs with no further questions; it resumes by itself after a crash or power cut and shows a report after the final reboot - failed steps can be retried. v4.6.35 - Add-on Portal: AIOStreams is listed (repository.taiseer) in the setup wizard, the AB Tools menu and the phone setup page, with the note "needs an AIOStreams server"; the Full preset does not tick it. v4.6.34 - a4kSubtitles: a subtitle search that finds nothing (TMDbHelper's split-second dummy playback) no longer stops automatic subtitle downloads until Kodi restarts. v4.6.33 - TMDbHelper 6.20.1: the Trakt "Next episodes" widget error (sync_succeeded) is fixed by back-porting Trakt sync 1.2.1's check into 1.2.0; skipped once 1.2.1 is installed. v4.6.32 - AIOStreams: while plugin.video.aiostreams is installed its TMDbHelper player is installed and switched on, and Search All lists its streams next to the other add-ons (played through AIOStreams itself). Older versions: see changelog.txt.
